messages:
riley: Quick async check — API GW / routing / auth / rate limits update.

What I did: patched token-refresh edge case in gw-proxy (PR #842)
Blockers: seeing sporadic 429s in canary when traffic spikes > 1k RPS, suspect batching/token refresh storm
Today: rolling a hotfix to staging, will shadow on alpha, need someone to approve a temporary canary weight bump

anya: noted. can you paste the failing log lines? :eyes: 

riley: log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:05:12Z gw-proxy ERROR token_refresh: attempt=3 status=502 downstream_err="upstream reset"
2026-03-17T14:05:14Z gw-proxy WARN rate_limit: bucket_exhausted user_id=svc-analytics
```

kevin: curious — are the 429s correlated with a specific route or JWT? last time we saw this it was `route:/v1/embeddings` bursting

riley: initial traces show it's spread across /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. token refresh failures cause short retries which pile up. thinking per-client refresh throttle + small jitter on retry.

sam: i can take the canary weight approval. what's the proposed new weight?

riley: bump from 10% -> 25% for 15m, then back to 10% if no regressions. PR: https://git.internal/r/rw/gw-proxy/pulls/842

anya: +1 to per-client refresh throttle. also add randomized backoff: `backoff = base * (1 + rand()*0.3)` — low-risk change.

marta: infra note: 25% canary will generate ~2x token refresh traffic on that shard. autoscale has headroom but please watch pod mem and auth-db p99.

ci-bot: deploy job started for riley/gw-proxy#842 — build 7821 (smoke checks queued)

sam: approving canary weight now, will watch smoke. ping me when smoke passes or for rollback. :thumbsup:

riley: thanks — will post a short status after staging smoke (ETA ~20m).
